description: This file implements the HistoryViewModel class for a calculator application, managing the history list including loading, adding, deleting, and clearing history items, as well as handling UI interactions and localization.

classes.name: HistoryViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class managing the history list of calculator operations, supporting reload, add, delete, and clear operations, with localization and UI notification features.

methods.name: ReloadHistory
methods.description: Reloads the history list based on the current calculator mode (Standard or Scientific).

methods.name: OnHistoryItemAdded
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new history item at a specified index.

methods.name: SetCalculatorDisplay
methods.description: Sets the calculator display callback for history updates.

methods.name: ShowItem
methods.description: Handles the event when a history item is selected for viewing.

methods.name: DeleteItem
methods.description: Deletes a specified history item from the list and updates the UI and localization.

methods.name: OnHideCommand
methods.description: Handles the hide command for the history view.

methods.name: GetMaxItemSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of history items allowed.
